blocks.text: After breakfast, a half-day panoramic city tour of Buenos Aires, one of South America’s most European and cosmopolitan cities. Drive along Avenida 9 de Julio, home to the renowned Teatro Colón and the Obelisk, and visit Plaza de Mayo, surrounded by historic buildings such as the Casa Rosada, the Cathedral and the City Hall. Continue to Plaza San Martín, Avenida Alvear and Plaza del Congreso, along historic Avenida de Mayo and lively Avenida Corrientes, through La Boca and San Telmo, elegant Palermo and Recoleta, and modern Puerto Madero.
